subject: Cost and Management Accounting
question_text:
(b)  A factory has three production departments, P1, P2, P3 and two service
departments S1, and S2 Both the service departments are independent and
provide services to each other. Following is the detail of expenses of each
service department:

You are required to apportion the expenses of departments S1 and S2 to

(4 Marks)
suggested_answer:
(b)  The total expenses of the two service departments will be determined as
follows:
S1

=  1,60,000 + 0.10 S2
S2

=  2,40,000 + 0.20 S1
Substituting the value of S1,
S2

=  2,40,000 + 0.20 (1,60,000 + 0.1 S2)

=  2,40,000 + 32,000 + 0.02 S2

=  2,72,000 + 0.02 S2
